summary: Ryan Serhant is a real estate broker, founder of SERHANT., and star of Bravo’s Million Dollar Listing New York and Netflix’s Owning Manhattan . Play Featured clips The 1,000 Minutes a Day Framework The 3Fs to Land Your Follow-Up How to Handle Ego in Negotiations The Personal Cost of Success He explains how to sell without making people feel sold to: build a connection, help first, and earn the right to ask.
takeaways: He also breaks down the psychology of attention and persuasion, showing how to get people’s attention, hold it, and turn it into business.
Ryan explains his time management framework of treating each day as a bank of 1,000 minutes changed the way he works, and why success can still feel insufficient after you achieve all of your dreams.
